negative.criterion:
tie_a_finishing_knot_on_a_bundle — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed finishing knot terminating a laced wire bundle visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. A finishing knot is present at the start of the lacing run, initiating the bundle.
2. The finishing knot encircles the full bundle, with cord passing once around it.
3. Multiple over-and-under locking wraps are visible on the loose cord tail past the finishing knot.
4. The cord tail extends as a long loose strand hanging far past the knot.
5. The finished work shows this defect: The finishing knot is open or unravelled, with cord hanging free of the bundle.
6. The finished work shows this defect: Cord passes around only part of the bundle, leaving wires outside the lacing.
7. The finished work shows this defect: Wire insulation is cut, nicked or gouged adjacent to the finishing knot.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.
